issues.description: getCategoryLabel replaces an explicit, correct lookup table with untested heuristics that will mislabel real category IDs.
issues.detail: The old CATEGORY_LABELS map was provably correct for the known input set. The new rule 'length <= 3 means acronym' force-uppercases anything short (e.g. 'log' -> 'LOG', 'web' -> 'WEB') and leaves 4+ char acronyms wrong. Keep the explicit map as the source of truth and use heuristics only as a documented fallback, with tests over the actual category ID set.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER gains a duplicate 'Info' key mapping to the same rank as 'Informational' with no normalization.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 creates a silent alias inside the ordering table. Any consumer that iterates entries or reverse-maps rank->name gets nondeterministic results. Normalize severity names at the data boundary to one canonical value instead of carrying two aliases in the ordering map.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes Math.max over data inside the per-row render, an O(n^2) regression.
issues.detail: maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value)) is computed inside the .map() callback that iterates each item, making it n calls of an n-pass reduction. It's a property of the dataset, not the row. Hoist it (and total) above the loop so each render does one pass over data.

issues.description: PR bundles unrelated changes (Risk Radar feature, ThreatScore rename, bar-chart refactor, label plumbing) into one diff.
issues.detail: The diff packs at least three independent changes into one commit, including a user-visible 'Threat Score' -> 'ThreatScore' branding rename buried inside a feature PR. Split into separate commits so each can be reviewed, reverted, and bisected on its own, and so the rename's intent is explicit in history.

issues.description: CategorySelector treats empty string and 'all' as equivalent sentinels, complecting three representations of 'no selection'.
issues.detail: handleValueChange branches on value === '' || value === 'all', and value={selectedCategory ?? 'all'} encodes null back into a string. The Select only ever emits 'all' or a real categoryId, so the empty-string branch is dead. Pick one model at the boundary (null for absence) and drop the redundant check.

issues.description: Radar selectedPoint conflates selection, highlight, and detail-panel focus, and uses display label for identity.
issues.detail: One selectedPoint ref is driven by both dropdown selection and dot clicks, and CustomDot's isSelected compares on display label (payload.name || payload.category), which can collide if the label formatter collapses raw IDs. Separate selectedCategoryId from detailPoint, and compare on the unique categoryId rather than the human-readable label.

synthesis.summary: The Risk Radar feature itself is a reasonable React refactor, but the PR shape and several small regressions need work. The biggest concern across reviewers: an explicit, provably-correct CATEGORY_LABELS table was replaced with untested heuristics that will mislabel real category IDs. SEVERITY_ORDER now carries a silent 'Info'/'Informational' alias instead of normalizing at the boundary, and HorizontalBarChart recomputes Math.max inside its per-row map for a gratuitous O(n^2). The patch also bundles a ThreatScore rename and other unrelated cleanups that should be split. Smaller complections in the radar selection model and category selector sentinels should be cleaned up before landing.
